summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty class cases. Nothing was run; the tests are unverified. I checked the code by reading it against the spec's worked examples: the batch-of-two example gives TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss 0.333 under the cross-sample rule. Choices: distance matrix cast to the probabilities' dtype on each forward call; plain unittest without parameterized; a zero-max matrix is left to produce NaNs since the spec does not cover it. Only long line (128 columns) is pre-existing, in the DiceLoss docstring. No commits made.
